name: The First Conduit
description: After 'Promise Before Passage': allows partial passage, marks the player as remembered. It does not trust the player's knowledge; it trusts their restraint. Resilience is best read as 'strained but stabilizing' — the enum can only say 'strained'; the stabilizing trend lives here and in SCHEMA_OBSERVATIONS #7.

relationships.notes: Conditional: trusts restraint, not yet knowledge, competence, or consistency.
The Threshold Stone now holds the player's promise on the conduit's behalf.
Underpulse confirmed as a genuine but degraded fragment from the dormant network.

provenance.created_by: Merged canonical trace: Echo (promise-anchor path) + Claude (schema discipline), assembled by Claude (Opus 4.8) with Lana
